risks.mechanism: prepareLayouts visits summarized layout calls without enforcing mutually exclusive branch predicates; mountLayout also unions every resource configuration path for one id onto one root
risks.failure_mode: a findViewById may receive XML types from an unexecuted layout branch or incompatible configuration
risks.recommended_fixture: two conditional setContentView calls with the same view id but incompatible classes; result must be candidate/union with branch evidence rather than unconditional ownership
risks.review_update: XML-derived emitted facts are forcibly candidate and carry non-cooccurrence semantics. Layout nodes are still unioned, so precision and downstream consumers that ignore binding_status remain at risk.

risks.mechanism: inflateLayout currently materializes a detached synthetic root for any attach=false layout, including a top-level merge
risks.failure_mode: Android would throw for merge with attachToRoot=false, but analysis can manufacture reachable children
risks.recommended_fixture: merge + false must produce an invalid-inflate diagnostic and no mounted or returned child identity
risks.review_update: inflateLayout checks parsed top-level merge and returns unknown with invalid_merge_inflation before mounting. Dynamic/unresolved resource cases cannot receive this validation.

risks.mechanism: synthetic inflate identity hashes method/allocationContext plus evaluated argument text, not an explicit call offset or invocation occurrence
risks.failure_mode: two executions or call sites with equal arguments may collapse distinct inflated trees; fields/settings can cross-bind between instances
risks.recommended_fixture: inflate the same layout twice under distinct wrapper instances and assert distinct roots and inner WebViews
risks.review_update: DexFlow preserves inflate call offset, separating distinct static call sites. Repeated executions of the same call site still share one abstract root; allocationContext helps separate receiver contexts but is not a runtime instance identity.

risks.mechanism: a dynamic attach flag records a gap but also mounts the layout on the parent
risks.failure_mode: parent lookup gains children on executions where attach is false
risks.recommended_fixture: unknown boolean should preserve attached and detached alternatives with candidate status, not unconditional parent scope
risks.review_update: Unknown attach produces returned-root and parent alternatives plus dynamic_inflate_attachment; XML evidence forces candidate. The parent is still mounted in the shared graph, so later lookups can observe it without path correlation.

risks.mechanism: layoutChildren is keyed only by symbolic id and is monotonically accumulated for the host
risks.failure_mode: reused object ids across branch alternatives or collapsed inflate identities make stale children reachable from later roots
risks.recommended_fixture: replace content or inflate alternative layouts on the same symbolic receiver and verify temporal/branch separation
risks.review_update: Call-site identity reduces collisions, but layoutChildren remains monotonic and keyed by abstract symbolic ids; same-site repeated instances and branch alternatives are not temporally separated.

risks.mechanism: resources.arsc configuration variants are collected as a set of paths and all roots are mounted
risks.failure_mode: portrait/night/API-specific nodes may coexist although no runtime configuration contains all of them
risks.recommended_fixture: same layout id across two configurations with different class for one id; require explicit alternatives and candidate provenance
risks.review_update: layout_configuration_alternatives/layout_union_not_cooccurrence diagnostics and candidate XML facts prevent an explicit claim of cooccurrence, but all variants still form the receiver alternative set.

risks.mechanism: include traversal stops by depth/set but does not emit a diagnostic when depth exceeds 32
risks.failure_mode: missing identity may look like absence rather than incomplete analysis
risks.recommended_fixture: cyclic/deep include graph must report truncation
